objective: §5.7 asked whether the measurement bar is worth 96 px of the name. The measurement shows the premise is void: the name is whole at 560, and the bar costs the source and the version.

the_finding.the_audit_measured: the row without its ladder: the name's cell is what the fixed columns leave — 0 px at 495, 65 px at 560 (43 px of text, six characters) — and the qualified minimum was 660 px
the_finding.the_row_actually_is: the ladder gives the name its floor (165 px of cell: the p90's 143 px of text and the identity glyph) and the columns that say *where* give way first — the source (weight 4), then the measurement (2), then the version (1); the size and the status never shrink
the_finding.the_measured_truth: at every width from 400 up the name's cell is 165 px and its text 143 px — the p90 whole. The name starts growing at 720 px (225/203), when the fixed columns are whole themselves.
the_finding.the_consequence: the catalogue's minimum is 560 px — the operator's target — and the window's floor is re-derived from it: 560 + 56 = 616 → 620, and the height 520 (the band 389 + the header 88 + the drawer 36 = 513). Measured at the floor: the catalogue 223 px (six rows), the plate 48 px.

the_two_shapes_measured.the_name_is_identical: the bar costs the name nothing at any width — the ladder gives the name its floor either way
the_two_shapes_measured.the_bar_degrades: its track is MEASURE_WIDTH (96) wide inside a cell the ladder narrows, right-justified and clipped: below 660 px the bar's *length* no longer encodes the size, and below 480 px the cell is 0 and the bar is gone

the_question_left_to_the_product: a bar whose length stops encoding below 660 px — is that reading worth the source and the version it squeezes? The size column, which never shrinks, shows the same number in bytes.

the_measurements.the_row_alone: the same numbers as the list — the ladder is the row's, proved in both
the_measurements.the_list: the catalogue's real list, at the catalogue's real height (36 px), at 400/480/495/520/560/660/720/800 — the name's cell 165 px from 400 up
the_measurements.the_composition_at_the_floor: 620 × 520: the catalogue 223 px (six rows), the plate 48 px
